'''Ankus''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] on the borders of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] near the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].

==History==
Discovered after the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the world did not join the galactic government, though there were some [[Cragmoloid/Legends|Cragmoloids]] living in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] during the time after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TEA" /> Following the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Ankus was invaded by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the natives were enslaved.<ref name="UAA" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] journeyed into the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]] in search of information on the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lords of the Sith]]. Directed to the Cragmoloid [[Boulad]], Typho was able to instantly gain a report that one [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] had traveled to the fire world of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] at the same time as the deceased [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] were thought to be there.<ref name="Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref>

Held by the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] throughout the [[Imperial Civil War]], [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]] was able to take command of this space in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]]. After Thrawn's death, Ankus became isolated and independent, as the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] was invaded by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] in [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]]. Remaining separate for nearly a century, the world was taken by [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] as of [[137 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />
